changelog: - **Bringing a large diagram into view zoomed out no longer stops the page for the names.** At a low zoom the canvas draws each zone’s name and the selected node’s name at a readable size, and to place them it reads where every line runs. That read was one piece of work: on the Early MMO (144 lines) about a second in which nothing on the page moved. It is now done a little in every frame, at most 16 ms, and 40 ms while a name is waiting to be shown. In the built app, bringing the whole MMO into view with View ▸ Reset view had a longest frame of about 1.2 s; it is about 0.2 s now. The names end up where they did. While the lines are still being read a new name waits for them, as it already waited for the routes, and a name that is already placed stays shown. Two things can differ: a node dragged in the first moments, while the lines are still being read (a few seconds on the MMO), has its name held back until they are read, for at most 1.5 s, and its side is then chosen where the node is by then, which can be another side than before; and where selecting a node makes the layer read lines again, as on a diagram whose lines are curved, its name can show 0.1 to 0.2 s later than before (measured on a development build).
